claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: BRL-50481 is a selective PDE7 inhibitor that does not kill cells broadly; at 2.5 uM it may selectively promote apoptosis in PDE7B-overexpressing CLL cells but is expected to be largely inactive across most cancer lines.
